column2: # Load necessary library to read data
# Summarize the data: calculate average quality of sleep
sleep_summary <- aggregate(data$`Quality of Sleep`, by = list(data$Occupation), FUN = mean, na.rm = TRUE)
# Sort the data for better visualization
family = "serif",        # Set font family to serif
cex.lab = 1.2,           # Increase axis title font size
cex.axis = 0.8           # Adjust font size for axis labels
col = brewer.pal(length(sleep_summary$Occupation), "Dark2"), # Use color scheme for the bars
main = "Average Quality of Sleep by Occupation",
las = 2,                  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
border = "black",         # Add a border around the bars
cex.names = 0.8           # Adjust font size for x-axis labels
